utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re set to check the list now and make sure everything’s ready for 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—let’s go through it now and make sure you’re all set for 10.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s go through the list and confirm we’re ready for 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be there a little later to help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Dane — the donations are stacked by the garage. Come by when you can, and we’ll sort them together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll swing by as soon as I can and help sort them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — just keep me posted, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Faye — I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s locked in, and I’ll bring the tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Gus — just send it over when you’ve got the time set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll grab gloves and a few basic tools first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll check the supply list and see what else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—let me know the next gap and I’ll grab it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still happening today. I’ll bring my toolbox and help with the fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep letting neighbors know the repair drive is still on today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll head over with the toolbox and get those boards fixed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush at all, Hana — just send me the time and spot when you’ve got them, and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on the final time and drop-off spot, and I’ll send them as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — I’ll keep the tools ready and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be at the community center on Sunday around 4 and help wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sam — Sunday at 4 works perfectly, and I’ll swing by after lunch to check what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday at 4 and ready to help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — Sunday at the community center should be much easier for everyone, and your help keeping it simple and welcoming will make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’m glad to help make Sunday at the community center smooth and welcoming. Just point me to whatever needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — let’s start by setting up the welcome table and a clear sign-in area, then we’ll walk through the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your latest drop-off details before I do anything. Let me know when you’re back, and I’ll keep the repair drive info straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m back with the latest: the drop-off is sorted, and I’ll share the rest in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’m ready for the rest of the details when you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: After lunch should be fine. I can send a little over quietly, and I’d appreciate you keeping it off to the side.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works—just send it after lunch, and I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll send it after lunch and keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll keep sending folks your way if they need repairs. And I’ll let Opal know what needs sorting so the drive stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you helping keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course—I'll keep folks coming your way if they need repairs. We’ll make sure the drive runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got it, Dane — I’m sorting the supplies now and making the missing-items list so we’re ready when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by a little later and help sort through it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll have everything laid out and the list ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s start with the squeaky porch door, then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds great, Mina — thanks. I’ll try to remember to bring the other repair stuff by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright — I’ll oil the porch door first. Anything else you want me to check after that?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — if you keep repeating the plan, I can focus on making the parking setup clear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, then I’ll keep the parking clear and simple so nobody gets stuck.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out while I finish errands and see if I can swing by later.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Ira — hope the errands wrap up soon, and I’ll let you know if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll be around after errands, so just let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—it's still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today. I’ll be there this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. See you this afternoon then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive around the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m just hearing bits and pieces, so I appreciate you keeping it going around the block.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive around the block.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I still don’t have the day and time yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — please let me know as soon as you have the day and time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll update you as soon as I get the day and time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll keep an eye on the parking and timing, and I can help sort the tools and spare parts too. Just point me at the list and I’ll do my best to keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — could you also check the list against what we already have? I’m just trying to make sure nothing gets missed before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely—I can cross-check the list against what’s already here and flag anything missing before Saturday. Just send it over and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet and swing by after lunch to check in. Glad to hear the repair drive is getting such a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That means a lot, Tess. Thank you for keeping it quiet and checking in later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep it low-key and check back after lunch. Hopefully they don’t need anything more than a hand or two.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Noah — I’ll keep spreading the word, and I can still help with a few fixes if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Noah — just keep me posted, and I’ll keep sharing the word and jump in on any small fixes if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday at the community center works for me—I’ll help sort the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey—thank you. We’ll start with the donations at the community center, then make the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I’ll be there Sunday and help with the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — keep them coming my way, and I’ll keep tracking the locations and sorting what comes in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Opal — I’ll keep sending people and anything needing sorting your way for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Quinn — I’ll stay on top of the locations and sort whatever comes in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — if you see the sign-up, could you let me know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll keep an eye out and tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate the update when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’m at 14 Maple, and I haven’t set anything out yet. I’ll let you know if I find a few more things.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got 14 Maple noted, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything you set out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll let you know as soon as I set something out.
